intro.h3: Unleash Brand Power - Shape a Sustainable Tomorrow
intro.h4:
Since its launch in 2022, BRAND BOOST has become an exclusive platform for all VIVOTEKers.
We’re all about turning ideas into action, pushing our company culture
—Quality, Teamwork, Speed, and Transparency—in every challenges.

review.h2Sub:
Shoutout to VIVOTEKers,
Over the past two years, BRAND BOOST has delivered these awesome results:

24th.title:
In 2024, we're extending our brand vision with a stronger focus on ESG,
working with our partners to build a brighter future!

01.title:
VIVOTEK Green Day × Teamwork 
｜Apr. 22
01.des: Celebrating The Earth Day, we partnered with the HAOSHI Foundation to create a lively market and insightful sessions. Driving sustainability awareness and highlighting VIVOTEK's #Teamwork culture.

02.title:
Global Search Challenge × Quality 
｜May. - Aug.
02.des: Spotting VIVOTEK products in iconic locations: form Paris metros, Dutch stations, to Japanese hotspots, etc., highlighting our superior #Quality and global influence.

03.title:
Global Step Challenge × Speed 
｜Sep. - Nov.
03.des: Constantly pushing boundaries! Over two years,  we have walked almost 130 million steps, resulting in a reduction around 30 tons of carbon emissions—that's like planting 2,489 trees! That’s how we leverage #Speed culture.

04.title:
The Group Vision × Transparency 
｜Nov. 29
04.des: Visiting Delta Group to explore smart buildings and sustainable development. Connect with their team, reinforcing VIVOTEK's culture of #Transparency.

23th.title:
In 2023, we expanded BRAND BOOST, crafting our brand culture.
Inspiring all VIVOTEKers to be the driver of our brand.

01.title:
The EXTREME Challenge × Quality 
｜Mar. - Jul.
01.des: Through the challenge, we showcased the global applications of VIVOTEK products. From the mountains of Taiwan to the Arabian Desert, our products perform reliably despite extreme temperature variations and various challenges,

02.title:
Brand Workshop × Teamwork 
｜May. 11
02.des: Collaborating to transform the product waste into creative, eco-friendly planters. Showcased both our dedication to environmental responsibility, #Teamwork and creativity.

03.title: The Eco-Walking Challenge × Speed｜Aug. - Nov.
03.des: To promote eco-friendly commuting, our FIRST Eco-Walking Challenge reached 80 million steps and highlighting our brand's #Speed culture. One VIVOTEKer achieved excellent results and successfully lost 17 kilograms, realizing a win-win for both health and sustainability.

04.title:
Company Visit × Transparency 
｜Nov. 29
04.des: We visited O'right to learn about their green building and sustainability initiatives. This experience will help us advance VIVOTEK's #Transparency and sustainable development, fulfilling our brand vision.

sep.text1: Participating in the company's 25th Anniversary 'Walk Out 25' event was deeply symbolic. It created wonderful memories, providing the momentum needed for us to move forward towards future success.
sep.text3: We walked the '25' at the Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, enjoying the greenery, Taipei Dome, and iconic Taipei 101. These beautiful sights celebrate VIVOTEK's 25th Anniversary as we strive to MAKES TOMORROW EASIER, TODAY!

oct.text1: I deliberately parked my scooter far away and walked to Guang Hua Digital Plaza, leaving 25th footprints along the way, taking in all the street scenes and alley views.
oct.text3: In the quaint and charming old city of Chiang Mai, leaving VIVOTEK's mark of 25.

nov.text1: Witnessing 25 years of growth and breakthroughs, I feel deeply honored to be part of this journey and look forward to reaching new heights together.
nov.text2: During my vacation, I explored the city's streets and alleys, leaving traces of '25' to celebrate the company's 25th anniversary. Make VIVOTEK great again.
nov.text3: Passing by Godzilla in Taipei, aka Tao Zhu Yin Yuan, to celebrate the happy 25th anniversary!!!
